author: Dave Smith
title: Apple will reportedly release a redesigned MacBook Air and new Mac Mini later this year (AAPL)
text: Apple will reportedly release a redesigned MacBook Air and new Mac Mini later this year (AAPL) By Dave Smith Aug 20, 2018, 3:39 pm 29 pts Apple will release a redesigned MacBook laptop and a new Mac Mini later this year, according to a recent report. The new laptop, which could be a MacBook or MacBook Air, will reportedly feature a 13-inch higher-resolution Retina display with thinner bezels, or borders, around the screen. The new Mac…
